params.caption: Rus tilini biladiganlar ko'pincha shu so'zda adashadi: "eventualno" ruschada "ehtimol, kerak bo'lsa" degani, inglizcha eventually esa umuman boshqa narsa. U "oxir-oqibat, axiyri" degan ma'noni beradi, ya'ni ancha vaqt yoki qiyinchilikdan keyin baribir sodir bo'lgan ish haqida. I failed the test twice, but eventually I passed. Ikki marta yiqildim, lekin oxiri o'tdim. The bus was late, but it eventually came. If you keep practising, you will eventually feel more confident. Yana bir farq: essedagi oxirgi fikrni sanab berishda Finally, ishlatiladi, Eventually, emas. Eventually doim "uzoq jarayondan keyin" degan ohangni olib yuradi.
